title: Monastery of Saint George of Choziba

source: OpenStreetMap St. George Monastery location and 1883 Survey of Western Palestine plan

mappedIdentity.name: Monastery of Saint George of Choziba
mappedIdentity.address: Wadi Qelt, Jericho Governorate, West Bank, Palestine

features.role: Cliffside monastery with a three-level set of chapels and rooms, retaining walls, hillside terraces and the stone approach bridge

identityStatus: The OSM monastery node and mapped approach anchor the historic core. The 1883 measured plan fixes shape and foundation scale where the monastery replaced earlier buildings. The rebuilt walls and arch profiles are interpreted from period images.

terrainContact.basis: Native Copernicus datum sampled along the south face of the mapped cliff ledge.

notes: The two post-rebuilding illustrations and the Patriarchate confirm the ordered levels, domes and cliffside construction. Model heights follow image proportions relative to the measured plan.
